headline: Why your blush fades by noon

scenes.say: Why does your blush disappear by noon? It's usually how you layer it, not the blush itself.
First, let your sunscreen and base sit for two minutes. Blush slides around on damp skin.
scenes.label: Step 1

scenes.say: Next, tap a cream or liquid blush onto your cheeks with your fingertip. Tap, don't swipe.
scenes.label: Step 2

scenes.say: Then dust a little powder blush in the same shade on top. Two thin layers stay put longer.
scenes.label: Step 3

scenes.say: The common mistake? One heavy layer of powder. It sits on top and wears off unevenly.
scenes.label: Common mistake

scenes.say: Which step do you skip? Tell me in the comments. The shopping link is in my profile.
